title: NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave

stats.done_summary: Successfully implemented numerical integration of traveling-wave ODE for porous medium equation. Created runnable code that solves the ODE using RK45 method with adaptive step size control. Generated comprehensive verification showing residuals on the order of 10^-17 to 10^-18, far below tolerance threshold. Produced publication-quality research report with methodology, results, figures, and quantitative verification measures. All deliverables complete: code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and report in report/ with 6 figures in report/images/.
